name: yukimi-gestion
description: Sistema interno de gestión para Yukimi

scripts.build: npm run build -w @yukimi/shared && npm run build -w @yukimi/api && npm run build -w @yukimi/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @yukimi/shared && npm run typecheck -w @yukimi/api && npm run typecheck -w @yukimi/web
scripts.test:db: npm run db:reset && npm run test:db:unit && npm run test:db:concurrency && npm run test:db:lint
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:migrations:static && npm run test:db:static && npm run test:ui:static && npm run build
